intro: Belgium's economy is built on trade, with one of Europe's largest ports, and it is world-famous for chocolate, beer and diamonds.

chapters.title: Ports and diamonds
text: Antwerp is one of the largest ports in Europe and a centre of the chemicals industry, and for centuries it has been one of the world's main diamond-trading cities. Belgium also makes medicines; vaccines for much of Europe were produced there during the COVID-19 pandemic.

chapters.title: Chocolate and beer
text: Belgian chocolate makers invented the praline in 1912, and AB InBev, based in Leuven, is the world's largest brewer. Belgium uses the euro.

keyTerms.meaning: In Belgium, a chocolate shell with a soft filling.
